title: Implement per-hierarchy topic routing (usenet.hier.<h> naming)
description:
Implement topic_for_group(group_name: &str) -> Topic: extract the top-level hierarchy (first component before the first dot), return TopicHash for 'usenet.hier.<hierarchy>'. Implement subscribe_hierarchies(groups: &[&str]) -> Vec<Topic>: compute the minimal set of hierarchy topics that cover all listed groups and subscribe. Artifact: transit/src/gossip/topics.rs.

Acceptance criteria:
- topic_for_group('comp.lang.rust') returns the same topic as topic_for_group('comp.os.linux')
- topic_for_group('sci.math') returns a different topic than topic_for_group('comp.lang.rust')
- subscribe_hierarchies(['comp.lang.rust', 'comp.os.linux', 'sci.math']) subscribes exactly 2 topics
- Single-component group names (e.g. 'local') map to 'usenet.hier.local'
- Unit tests cover all cases above
